# Third-party notices

The library runtime has no third-party dependencies.

The PSB container research in `docs/format-research.md` uses terminology and
facts published by the Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0 cadmpeg project. The compact
`SolidPrimdata` array grammar in `src/primdata.ts` is an independent TypeScript
adaptation of cadmpeg-codec-creo's Apache-2.0 `primdata.rs` implementation:
<https://github.com/cadmpeg/cadmpeg>. No cadmpeg runtime code is included.
